summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K furnishing an intimation that its Board of Directors will meet on October 23, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the US-equivalent of a routine earnings-notice filing under SEBI LODR Regulation 29. The filing also notes the trading window closes September 24, 2026 through October 25, 2026 under SEBI insider-trading rules. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is described; the event is an ordinary quarterly results scheduling notice with no deal terms.
